request_id.description: Stable upload retry key scoped to the authenticated user and workspace.

management.description: Requires enterprise management permission without granting runtime membership.

owner_id.description: Optional explicit initial owner when creating a Team from a department. Must be the creator or the current eligible department leader. Creator retains a manual manager grant; no other directory members are copied.

management.description: Requires enterprise management permission without granting runtime membership.

disable_knowledge_capture.description: Immutable per-command opt-out from declared business capture

filename_hint.description: Safe leaf filename with the matching format extension; server also checks the UTF-8 byte length.

file_id.description: Only present after an authorized active stored file and generation receipt satisfy this requirement.

TaskSubjectRef.description: Server-derived original subject. An empty historical object means unresolved identity, never the execution account or a shared audience.

ApplicationKnowledgeAccess.description: Omission preserves previous or legacy configuration. An explicit empty object selects no extra knowledge bases. The default write base must also be in read_base_ids. Server-issued capture authority is never client input.

conversation_id.description: Lightweight employee directory identity; no messages

scheduled.description: Original scheduled intake confirmed by its scoped occurrence; directory metadata only

read_only.description: Server-enforced read-only delegation inherited by descendants

files.description: Explicit empty array clears previous turn file selection; omission preserves it.

human_task_pending.description: Filter authorized current-epoch pending human tasks before pagination

delegate_resources.description: Explicitly delegates only installed read resources to members of the selected team or project. Does not grant source management or database write access.

EnvironmentKnowledgeModels.description: Explicit knowledge model roles, each referencing model_config_ids in the same immutable environment version. No workspace-default fallback.

allow_registered_agent_tools.description: Allow pinned registered read-only tools of direct Application Agents with per-invocation authorization.

kind.description: Executable kinds are agent and workflow; unsupported kinds remain unpublishable drafts.

version_id.description: Original domain immutable release or snapshot primary key

description.description: Business purpose, at most 500 Unicode code points after trimming Unicode whitespace. Optional in drafts and historical versions; required on new publications only for capabilities exposed as Agent tools.

context_input_key.description: Optional Workflow object input field that receives server-compiled work context

test_user_id.description: Administrative admission check only; requires organization and RBAC management for a different user.

org_unit_id.description: Omit for all visible entries; empty selects company-level entries.
Empty places the employee at company level.

origin.description: Optional source selector; never an authorization grant.

view.description: List projection; omit for detail. Timeline includes changes to currently accessible non-deleted memories.

origin.description: Optional source selector; never an authorization grant.

identity_ref.description: Internal observed identity reference. Never a provider account ID.

display_label.description: Masked label for the observed identity.

confirm_share.description: Explicit confirmation by the authenticated record owner.

display_label.description: Masked label; omitted when the identity is no longer currently observable.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation by the current logged-in user.
Explicit confirmation by the current logged-in user.

team_id.description: Optional home Team; omitted for unaffiliated drafts. Historical applications are not guessed.

ApplicationBindingListRequest.description: Scope fields must be supplied together. Omission preserves workspace-only listing; explicit space selection is authorized and filtered before pagination.

management.description: Requires unified management permission; includes disabled bindings for configuration without granting runtime membership.

current_version.description: Definition version only; zero means unpublished

team_id.description: Home Team space ID; empty when unaffiliated

core_capabilities.description: Core capabilities of the pinned primary Agent release

version_sequence.description: Internal immutable sequence used for optimistic and relational consistency

core_capabilities.description: Core capabilities of the pinned primary Agent release

incompatible.description: True only when input/output schema breaking is proven

type.description: Supported types: string, integer, number, boolean, array, object.

value.description: Non-secret default. Non-string types use JSON text (for example 3, true, or ["A","B"]). Defaults are applied before execution validation; schema mode does not apply JSON Schema defaults.

source.description: RFC 6901 pointer into tool input, such as /filter/ids. Empty string selects the entire input.

name.description: Query key or top-level JSON body key. Empty name selects the entire body; cannot be mixed with other body mappings.

encoding.description: Query defaults to scalar. repeat sends an array as repeated keys; json encodes one JSON value. Body always preserves JSON types.

required.description: Fail if the source pointer is absent; otherwise omit that destination. Null is a present JSON value.

value.description: Requester-supplied value. Sensitive values are write-only.
Omitted when the stored header is sensitive.

HTTPToolCredentialAction.description: Explicit edit intent for write-only credential headers.

input_schema.description: Full JSON Schema 2020-12 with object root and local references, at most 16 KiB. Omit/empty for simple params; nonempty input_schema and params are mutually exclusive.

output_schema.description: Full response envelope schema (status_code, headers, body, raw_body), at most 16 KiB. Customize body and local definitions; omit/empty for the standard unrestricted body.

request_mapping.description: Separate HTTP mapping, available with input_schema. GET/DELETE allow query only. No mappings means direct input keys to query or a JSON body. URL/method/headers/credentials remain fixed.

include_definition_snapshot.description: Read the exact immutable publication after current definition-read authorization. Omitted for ordinary status polls.

metadata.description: JSON object encoded as a string

web_search_enabled.description: Allow the Agent to search and read public web pages. Defaults to false on create; omission preserves the current value on update.

workflow_bindings.description: Desired complete set of Workflow bindings. On update, omission or null keeps the current set; an empty array appends disabled versions for enabled bindings. A semantic change appends an immutable version. Binding identity, version and side effect are assigned by Go. The fixed published snapshot is checked again on save and publish; waiting or unknown capabilities are rejected. This field is independent of plugin_config.enabled. Read back the server result after saving.

workflow_snapshot_id.description: Fixed published Workflow snapshot; never resolved to the latest snapshot.

display_name.description: User-facing Workflow tool name. The server derives the model-visible tool_name from the binding identity.

enabled.description: Omission or null is treated as false.

confirmation_policy.description: Go derives side effect from the fixed snapshot. Non-idempotent writes require required; read-only and idempotent writes may use either policy.

AgentPublishRequest.description: Freezes the enabled Workflow binding references in the Agent Release. A later binding edit does not replace these references. Stale derived capability facts require a configuration update before publication; publishing never silently appends binding versions.

run_mode.description: Debug freezes the current enabled Workflow binding versions. Published freezes the selected Release references after checking that their latest logical bindings are still enabled. Existing Runs retain their assigned versions after later configuration changes.

agent_release_id.description: Existing Agent Release selected for published execution; not a Workflow snapshot ID.

invocation_source.description: Workflow tools are assembled only for eligible authenticated top-level web or api Runs. Share, channel and workflow Runs receive no Workflow tools; a client-supplied source alone never grants execution authority.

workflow_bindings.description: Latest immutable version of each binding, including disabled entries; empty when no binding exists.

status.description: Agent run lifecycle status. A succeeded run ended normally; it does not by itself verify a broader business outcome.

AgentExecutionSummary.description: Runtime facts about the model/tool loop. Tool failures remain visible in calls and do not automatically redefine a normally ended Agent run as a failed business task.

space_id.description: Optional immutable team or project space ownership.

metadata.description: JSON object encoded as a string

KnowledgeUploadDestination.description: Frozen team upload target; only newly created files are registered here. Existing deduplicated files retain their location.

request_id.description: Required for native file retries; replay the same identity when the response is uncertain.

expected_actions.description: Native item ID to currently observed native_request_id; stale actions are rejected.

surface.description: Return only operations that may be projected to this surface.

resource.description: Return one exact normalized resource type.

operation.description: Return one exact operation ID, action, or capability key.

include_schemas.description: Inline request and response schemas when true.

legacy_migration.description: Explicit one-way migration of an existing Agent Binding. Requires expected_binding_version > 0, an explicit sender allowlist, and no publication_id. Preserves enabled state; records the old target in audit. No reverse migration.

allowed_sender_identity_ids.description: Explicit external consumer allowlist scoped by the server to workspace, provider and connection. Empty denies all senders.

external_subject_confirmation.description: Exact external subject confirmation; transient input only, never persisted or logged.
